labels.caption: The one-way guard (Algorithm~1 without projection) around three inner policies, at Algorithm~1's defaults, on the one-day instances I1--I4 and the exact core families of Fig.~\ref{fig:guard}'s study. (a) The share of runs that abort under each lender: a bar over the instances that ran the lender (each weighted by its runs), ended by the policy's marker, and a dot per instance. (b) Under the trace lender, the median over the cells of the guarded configuration's cost over its inner policy's on the same cell, with its 95\% bootstrap interval. (c) Empirical distribution of $\mathrm{ALG}(T)$ over the run's certificate bound over the 1,394 runs of each configuration (864 full-model runs, with the bound of Theorem~\ref{thm:fullmodel}, proven where all-fallback follows an abort and conjectured otherwise; 530 core exports, with the bound of Theorem~\ref{thm:envelope}). The bound held in all 6,140 runs of the one-way guard (largest ratio 1.0000). Markers stop at a ratio of 0.99: 28\% (Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard), 41\% (PD heuristic + one-way guard) and 44\% (Greedy + one-way guard) of the runs lie within 1\% of the bound.
